title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR — sin precedes imputation; need conjunction with sinner (Amyraut)
pass_a_gloss: Someone sins before sin is imputed. The one charged need not have done the act himself first, but must be joined to the one who did—Amyraut's point already taught.
pass_b_english: It is sinned first by someone, before sin is imputed; but it is not necessary that by that very one to whom sin is imputed, sin should first have been by act; but it is necessary that he have some conjunction with him who sinned, and whose sin is imputed to him, as the learned Amyraut taught before.
source_text: Peccatur prius ab aliquo, quam peccatum imputetur; sed non est necessarium, ut ab eo ipso cui peccatum imputatur, prius actu peccatum fuerit; sed necessarium est, ut aliquam habeat coniunctionem cum eo qui peccavit, & cuius peccatum ei imputatur, sicut antea docuit Clar. Amyraldus.

choices.choice: Prior act by someone + bond to sinner enough (Amyraut)
